chunks: Abi (may Allah have mercy on him) from Sa’d ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Sayf ibn ‘Umayra from a man from Abi Ja’far (peace be upon him) who said:

One who recites 'Inna anzalnahu fi laylati al-qadr' (Surely We sent it down in the Night of Power) loudly with his voice is like the one who draws his sword in the way of Allah, Exalted and Glorious; and one who recites it quietly is like the one smeared with his blood in the way of Allah; and one who recites it ten times, Allah will erase a thousand sins from his sins.

key_terms.إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَد: The opening phrase of Surah Al-Qadr, referring to the revelation of the Quran in the Night of Power.
key_terms.سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: In the way of Allah, often referring to jihad or striving in divine cause.
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of Power/Decree, a holy night in Ramadan.
key_terms.مُجْهِرًا: Loudly, audibly, with a clear voice.

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Qadr ten times according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elevates the recitation of Surah Al-Qadr by comparing its spiritual reward to the highest forms of jihad: loud recitation is likened to drawing a sword, while silent recitation to shedding blood, emphasizing the versatility of worship. The promise of erasing a thousand sins for ten recitations underscores the Surah’s unique status as a concise summary of divine decree and the Night of Power, a theme deeply cherished in Shia devotional practice.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. Abi (rah) from Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ahmad b. Muhammad from al-Hassan b. Mahbub from Sayf b. ’Umayra from a man from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said: “

One who recites Surah Qadr loudly is like a person who raises sword in the way of Allah and one who recites Surah Qadr in low voice is like a person who is smeared in blood fighting in the way of Allah. One who recites it ten times, Allah will forgive one thousand sins committed by him.”
